item.title: Lionel Messi Fires Back at Argentina Critics: “No One Has Given Us Anything”
item.description: Following Argentina's dramatic 2-1 World Cup semifinal comeback win over England in Atlanta, Lionel Messi responded to critics in the mixed zone, asserting that the squad has fully earned its spot in the final and owes nothing to anyone.
